{{< include _db-setup.qmd >}}

```{ojs}
//| output: false

L = require("https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js")

home_lat  = 55
home_lng  = 5
home_zoom = 5

elements = [
  { label: "Cobalt (CO)",      value: "CO" },
  { label: "Copper (CU)",      value: "CU" },
  { label: "Manganese (MN)",   value: "MN" },
  { label: "Molybdenum (MO)",  value: "MO" },
  { label: "Selenium (SE)",    value: "SE" },
  { label: "Zinc (ZN)",        value: "ZN" }
]
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
mutable clicked_point = null
```

```{ojs}
//| panel: sidebar

viewof selected_element = Inputs.select(elements, {
  label: "Element:",
  format: d => d.label,
  value: elements[0]
})

// --- Year range ---
year_range_result = db.query(`
  SELECT MIN(m.year) AS min_year, MAX(m.year) AS max_year
  FROM sediment s
  JOIN measurement_time m ON m.measurement_time_id = s.measurement_time_id
  WHERE s.parameter = '${selected_element.value}'
`)

min_year = year_range_result[0].min_year ?? 1984
max_year = year_range_result[0].max_year ?? 2024

viewof year_start = Inputs.range(
  [min_year, max_year],
  { label: "Year from:", step: 1, value: min_year }
)

viewof year_end = Inputs.range(
  [min_year, max_year],
  { label: "Year to:", step: 1, value: max_year }
)

// --- Organization list (updates when element changes) ---
organisation_result = db.query(`
  SELECT DISTINCT organisation
  FROM sediment s
  JOIN station s2 ON s2.station_no = s.station_no
  WHERE s.parameter = '${selected_element.value}'
  AND s2.organisation IS NOT NULL
`)

organisation_options = ["All", ...organisation_result.map(r => r.organisation)]

viewof selected_organisation = Inputs.select(organisation_options, {
  label: "Organisation:",
  value: "All"
})
```

```{ojs}
//| panel: fill

// Reusable organisation WHERE fragment — empty string when "All" is selected
organisation_filter = selected_organisation === "All"
  ? ""
  : `AND s2.organisation = '${selected_organisation}'`

// --- Value range query (for legend and colour scale) ---
value_range_result = db.query(`
  SELECT
    param,
    MIN(avg_value) AS min_avg_value,
    MAX(avg_value) AS max_avg_value
  FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        s1.parameter AS param,
          AVG(
            CASE
              WHEN s1.unit = 'mg/kg' THEN s1.measured_value * 1000
              WHEN s1.unit = 'ug/kg' THEN s1.measured_value
              ELSE NULL
            END
          ) AS avg_value
      FROM sediment s1
      JOIN station s2 ON s2.station_no = s1.station_no
      JOIN survey s3 ON s3.survey_id = s1.survey_id
      JOIN measurement_time m ON m.measurement_time_id  = s1.measurement_time_id
      WHERE s1.parameter = '${selected_element.value}'
       AND m.year BETWEEN ${year_start} AND ${year_end}
           ${organisation_filter}
        GROUP BY s1.parameter, s3.station_latitude, s3.station_longitude
  ) t
  GROUP BY t.param
`)

value_min = value_range_result[0]?.min_avg_value ?? 0
value_max = value_range_result[0]?.max_avg_value ?? 1

// --- Map data query ---
map_data = db.query(`
  SELECT
    s3.station_latitude AS latitude,
    s3.station_longitude AS longitude,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN s1.unit = 'mg/kg' THEN s1.measured_value * 1000
        WHEN s1.unit = 'ug/kg' THEN s1.measured_value
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) AS avg_value_ug_per_kg
  FROM sediment s1
  JOIN station s2 ON s2.station_no = s1.station_no
  JOIN survey s3 ON s3.survey_id = s1.survey_id
  JOIN measurement_time m ON m.measurement_time_id  = s1.measurement_time_id
  WHERE s1.parameter = '${selected_element.value}'
    AND m.year >= ${year_start}
    AND m.year <= ${year_end}
    AND s1.measured_value IS NOT NULL
    ${organisation_filter}
  GROUP BY s3.station_latitude, s3.station_longitude
`)

// --- Colour scale using element + year + country specific range ---
colorScale = d3.scaleSequential()
  .domain([value_min, value_max])
  .interpolator(d3.interpolateYlOrRd)

function markerColor(v) {
  return v == null ? "#aaa" : colorScale(v)
}

function fmtVal(v) {
  return v == null ? "N/A"
    : v >= 1000  ? (v / 1000).toFixed(0) + " mg/kg"
    : v.toFixed(0) + " µg/kg"
}

// --- Render / update map ---
{
  const container = html`<div class="map-container"><div id="map"></div></div>`
  yield container

  if (!container._map) {
    const map = L.map(container.querySelector("#map"), { zoomControl: true })
      .setView([home_lat, home_lng], home_zoom)

    L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
      attribution: "© OpenStreetMap contributors"
    }).addTo(map)

    const HomeControl = L.Control.extend({
      options: { position: "topleft" },
      onAdd(map) {
        const btn = L.DomUtil.create("a", "leaflet-home-button")
        btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fa fa-expand" aria-hidden="true"></i>'
        btn.title = "Reset to default view"
        btn.setAttribute("aria-label", "Reset to default view")
        L.DomEvent.on(btn, "click", (e) => {
          L.DomEvent.stopPropagation(e)
          map.setView([home_lat, home_lng], home_zoom)
        })
        return btn
      }
    })
    new HomeControl().addTo(map)

    const LegendControl = L.Control.extend({
      options: { position: "bottomright" },
      onAdd() {
        const div = L.DomUtil.create("div", "legend")
        div.id = "map-legend"
        return div
      }
    })
    new LegendControl().addTo(map)

    container._map     = map
    container._markers = L.layerGroup().addTo(map)
  }

  const { _map: map, _markers: markers } = container

  // Update legend — includes organisation in subtitle when filtered
  const legendEl = map.getContainer().querySelector("#map-legend")
  if (legendEl) {
    const organisationLabel = selected_organisation === "All" ? "All organisations" : selected_organisation
    legendEl.innerHTML = `
      <div class="legend-title">${selected_element.label}</div>
      <div style="font-size:11px;color:#555">
        Avg (µg/kg) · ${year_start}–${year_end} · ${organisationLabel}
      </div>
      <div class="legend-bar"></div>
      <div class="legend-labels">
        <span>${fmtVal(value_min)}</span> &nbsp;
        <span>${fmtVal((value_min + value_max) / 2)}</span> &nbsp;
        <span>${fmtVal(value_max)}</span>
      </div>
    `
  }

  markers.clearLayers()
  mutable clicked_point = null

  for (const d of map_data) {
    if (d.avg_value_ug_per_kg == null) continue
    const circle = L.circleMarker([d.latitude, d.longitude], {
      radius:      7,
      fillColor:   markerColor(d.avg_value_ug_per_kg),
      color:       "#333",
      weight:      0.8,
      opacity:     1,
      fillOpacity: 0.85
    })
    circle.bindTooltip(
      `<b>${selected_element.label}</b><br>
       Avg: ${fmtVal(d.avg_value_ug_per_kg)}<br>
       (${year_start}–${year_end})`,
      { sticky: true }
    )
    circle.on("click", () => {
      mutable clicked_point = { lon: d.longitude, lat: d.latitude }
    })
    markers.addLayer(circle)
  }
}

map_data.length === 0
  ? md`*No data found for this selection.*`
  : md`**${selected_element.label}** · ${year_start}–${year_end} · ${selected_organisation} · **${map_data.length}** locations · values in µg/kg`
```

```{ojs}
// --- Detail table on click ---

point_data = {
  const p = clicked_point
  if (!p) return []
  // In the detail query the project station is s2, so adjust the organisation filter alias
  const detail_organisation_filter = selected_organisation === "All"
    ? ""
    : `AND s2.organisation = '${selected_organisation}'`
  return db.query(`
      SELECT
        s2.organisation AS Organisation,
        s2.project_affiliation AS Project,
        s3.station_latitude AS Latitude,
        s3.station_longitude AS Longitude,
        CAST(CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) AS TEXT) AS Year,
        s1.parameter AS Param,
        UPPER(SUBSTR(p.parameter_name, 1, 1)) || LOWER(SUBSTR(p.parameter_name, 2)) AS Name
        s1.sediment_no AS "No",
        s4.layer_upper_boundary AS "From",
        s4.layer_lower_boundary AS "To",
        s1.measured_value AS Value,
        s1.unit AS Unit
      FROM sediment s1
      JOIN station s2 ON s2.station_no = s1.station_no
      JOIN survey s3 ON s3.survey_id = s1.survey_id
      JOIN measurement_time m ON m.measurement_time_id  = s1.measurement_time_id
      JOIN parameter p ON p.parameter  = s1.parameter
      JOIN sample s4 ON s4.sample_no  = s1.sample_no
      WHERE s1.parameter = '${selected_element.value}'
        AND m.year >= ${year_start}
        AND m.year <= ${year_end}
        AND s3.station_longitude = ${p.lon}
        AND s3.station_latitude  = ${p.lat}
        AND s1.measured_value IS NOT NULL
        ${detail_organisation_filter}
      ORDER BY m.year, s1.sediment_no
  `)
}

clicked_point
  ? md`### Measurements at (${clicked_point.lat.toFixed(2)}, ${clicked_point.lon.toFixed(2)})`
  : md`*Click a point on the map to see its measurements.*`

clicked_point ? Inputs.table(point_data, { layout: "auto" }) : html`<span></span>`
```
